0022600191.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers, playing their 10th game of the season, host the New York Knicks with a 5-4 record, a 4-1 home mark, and a win in their last game, sitting 2nd in the Central 1.5 games back and 5th in the East. New York is 4-4 overall, 3rd in the Atlantic 3 games back and 6th in the East, and has won its last two. Cleveland is missing Jarrett Allen (knee), Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain), and Sam Merrill (elbow), New York is without Josh Hart (ankle), and the teams have yet to meet this season, though the Cavaliers lost 1-2 in the 2025-26 season series and 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 130-93 loss in Cleveland on May 25, 2026.
